provider_real_merge.evidence: dispatch_merge(GitWorktreeProvider, task, payload) with matching expected_target_commit produced a real 40-hex merge commit (parents=2, cat-file=commit, feat_in_target=True); no simulated placeholders.

fallback_simulated.evidence: gate.py source line 70 calls validate_merge(task, payload) when provider is None; test_no_provider_* (2 tests) pass and return payload has_conflict/result_commit verbatim.

payload_no_repo_dir.evidence: git.merge payload accepted by dispatch_merge/service only carries source_ref, target_ref, expected_target_commit; a forged payload repo_dir='/nonexistent/agent-supplied-repo-dir' was ignored and the provider resolved its own internal repo_dir.

trusted_only_injection.evidence: IntegrationContractService.__init__(self, store, *, git_provider=None, **kwargs); repo_dir lives inside GitWorktreeProvider, never a kwarg exposed to agent Command; integration/service.py comment states 'Trusted-only ... never comes from an Agent Command'.

conflict_no_silent_rebase.evidence: GitWorktreeProvider.merge returns {'status':'conflict','conflict_paths':['base.txt']} and aborts; probe confirmed target tip unchanged after conflict. No rebase/resolve fallback.

important.statement: dispatch_merge(provider is not None) 自身不校验 task['status']==ready_for_integration，直接执行 provider.merge。以 status=verified 的 task 直接调用 dispatch_merge 会真实合并成功（探针 result_commit=a103d18...，feat_in_target=True）。
important.assessment: 不阻断接受：正式 IntegrationContractService 路径经核心 CommandHandler 守卫（guards.command_error -> validate_merge）先拦截，探针证实 status=verified 从 service 提交 git.merge 得到 rejected INVALID_TASK_STATUS 且仓库未变。风险仅存在于把 dispatch_merge 当公开纯函数直调的场景。
important.recommendation: 后续切片在 dispatch_merge 的两个分支统一做 task status 前置校验（或显式注释声明 dispatch_merge 仅供 service 层在守卫之后调用），消除函数级防御性不一致。

minor.statement: provider=None 时仍走旧模拟 validate_merge 路径，此为设计保留的向后兼容行为，非缺陷。
